title: Fast Company publishes Incorruptible excerpt: 'Our fears about AI are really fears about capitalism'
summary: Fast Company ran an excerpt from Incorruptible under Eric's byline in its Work Life section on publication day. The excerpt opens on Ted Chiang's line that anxiety about AI is really anxiety about capitalism, and turns it into the book's case about institutions outgrowing the people who built them.
blockquote: Our fears about AI mirror something older and more dangerous: institutions that evolve beyond human control.
attribution_title: Work Life — launch-day book excerpt, May 26, 2026
